STATE FORENSIC SCIENCE LABORATORY (SFSL), SECTOR 14, ROHINI, DELHI
CYBER FORENSICS & HARDWARE EXTRACTION DIVISION
Laboratory Case Ref: SFSL/CYB/2026/089 | FIR: 0419/2026 PS Mandir Marg
Subject: Forensic analysis of Seagate 4TB Enterprise HDD (EVI-2026-0001)
Cryptographic Hash: SHA-256 a7b8c9d0e1f234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef123456
Findings:
1. Master Boot Record and Event Logs show persistent backdoor executable named "svchost_update.exe" scheduled via Windows Task Scheduler at 03:00 AM daily.
2. Malware established reverse SSH tunnel to remote C2 server located at 185.220.101.44.
3. Cryptographic salt embedded in payload: "SHADOW_SALT_2026_X".
4. User account "d_mukherjee" used for initial authentication via internal VPN bridge.
Conclusion: Compromise required both high-level insider credentials and specialized malware engineering.

Name: Manish Tyagi | Age: 38 Years | Designation: Senior System Administrator, Apex Co-op Bank
Recorded by: Inspector Kabir Sharma, Special Cell
Statement: "I was on duty on the night of 13-14 January 2026. Around 03:15 AM, the cooling fans in Server Rack 2 ramped up to maximum speed. When I attempted to log in to the administrative console from my workstation, my password was rejected. I noticed terminal windows running automated batches. I immediately telephoned Ms. Pooja Bhattacharya and switched off the primary internet optical gateway at 04:18 AM, but by then the automated RTGS transfer batches had completed transmission."
